RecipeDef.label: clone nian beast
RecipeDef.description: Take DNA from a nian beast's corpse and copy it, then spend a while pouring in the right culture medium and running the rig, and out comes a nian beast of your own - one whose fire breath clears a crowd of enemies for the colony.
